import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Unbundled.RingSeminorm
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.AbsoluteValue
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds
#check_failure Roth.diag_eq_sum
namespace DiagSumRaw
open MvPolynomial
variable {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
theorem generic (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval (fun _ ↦ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) P =
      ∑ k ∈ P.support, Polynomial.monomial k.degree (P.coeff k) := by
  classical
  rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finsupp.degree_apply, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
theorem existingExpansion (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval (fun _ ↦ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) P =
      ∑ k ∈ P.support, Polynomial.monomial k.degree (P.coeff k) := by
  classical
  simpa only [MvPolynomial.aeval_def, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    ← Finsupp.degree_apply, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial] using
    (eval₂_eq (algebraMap R (Polynomial R)) (fun _ ↦ Polynomial.X) P)
#check @MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_def
#check @Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum
#check @Finsupp.degree_apply
#check @Polynomial.algebraMap_eq
#check @Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial
#print axioms generic
#print axioms existingExpansion
end DiagSumRaw

@aeval_def : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {S₁ : Type u_4} {σ : Type u_5} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (aeval f) p = eval₂ (algebraMap R S₁) f p

@Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum : ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (a : M),
  ∏ i ∈ s, a ^ f i = a ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i

@Finsupp.degree_apply : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] (d : σ →₀ R),
  Finsupp.degree d = ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i
@Polynomial.algebraMap_eq : ∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R], algebraMap R (Polynomial R) = Polynomial.C

@Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ},
  Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n = (Polynomial.monomial n) a
